description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultDittoJsonHandler class, which manages the construction and parsing of JSON structures such as arrays and objects. It provides methods for starting and ending JSON arrays and objects, handling various JSON value types, and generating JSON strings.

classes.name: DefaultDittoJsonHandler
classes.description: A thread-unsafe handler for JSON serialization and parsing, utilizing builders for JSON arrays and objects, implementing the DittoJsonHandler interface.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of DefaultDittoJsonHandler.

methods.name: startArray
methods.description: Initializes a JSON array construct, returning a new list of JsonValues.

methods.name: startObject
methods.description: Initializes a JSON object construct, returning a new list of JsonFields.

methods.name: endString
methods.description: Handles a string JSON value, escaping special characters.

methods.name: endNumber
methods.description: Handles a numeric JSON value, parsing string to the appropriate number type.

methods.name: endArrayValue
methods.description: Finalizes an array element and updates the accumulating JSON string.

methods.name: endArray
methods.description: Finalizes the JSON array, closing brackets and constructing a JsonValue.

methods.name: endObjectValue
methods.description: Finalizes a key-value pair in a JSON object.

methods.name: endObject
methods.description: Finalizes the JSON object, constructing a JsonValue.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current JsonValue being constructed.
